text:
```yaml
name: Lint
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.go'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
      - '.golangci.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/lint.yml'

jobs:
  golangci:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'
          cache: true
      - name: Install golangci-lint
        run: make install-golangci-lint
      - name: Run golangci-lint
        run: make lint
```
